weather_comment: Partly cloudy, 15c maximum. Very high chance of rain, most likely late this afternoon and evening. Winds northerly 15 to 25 km/h increasing to 25 to 40 km/h in the morning then tending northwesterly 15 to 25 km/h in the late evening.

Top of 15, Partly cloudy. Slight chance of a shower about the Dandenongs, near zero chance elsewhere. Light winds becoming west to southwesterly 15 to 20 km/h during the day then becoming light during the afternoon.
Top of 16 degrees, Partly cloudy. Light winds becoming northerly 15 to 20 km/h in the middle of the day then becoming light in the early afternoon.
